verdict.rationale: The pricing page documents the basic model: pay-as-you-go with no up-front costs and billing per product at per-second granularity. A free trial also lets you trial a workload before committing. However, nothing in the evidence shows published unit rates or a pricing calculator, which are what you need to turn a workload into a monthly estimate. Budgets help track spend after the fact, not forecast it beforehand. Missing for 10: published per-unit rates per product/tier, a pricing calculator or estimation guide, worked cost examples, independent confirmation that bills can be estimated accurately.
